name: Equatorial Guinea
capital: Ciudad de la Paz (Malabo during the transition)

flag.description: Three horizontal stripes of green, white and red, with a blue triangle at the hoist and the national coat of arms, a silk-cotton tree beneath six stars, in the centre of the white stripe.
flag.symbolism: Green represents natural resources, white peace, red the struggle for independence, and blue the sea linking the mainland and islands; the six stars are the mainland and the five islands.

hook: Equatorial Guinea stacks green-white-red with a blue hoist triangle and a silk-cotton tree in the middle; the tree is its giveaway.
trivia: It is the only sovereign African country with Spanish as an official language.
In January 2026 the capital was officially moved from Malabo, on Bioko island, to Ciudad de la Paz, a planned city on the mainland.
